none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization on a real Hilbert space. The objective satisfies the global quadratic upper bound with L > 0. A minimizer xstar exists with ‖x0 − xstar‖ ≤ R.

oracle.label: inexact_gradient
oracle.details: A query x returns only a vector g satisfying ‖g − ∇f(x)‖ ≤ α‖∇f(x)‖ for every history and seed. No function values, unbiasedness, or independence are assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: The pointwise relative error may be adversarial and history dependent. It satisfies 0 ≤ α < 1 and α ≤ 1/[100(33(1 + log(2 + LR²/ε)))¹²].

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space, potentially infinite dimensional. E, L, x0, α, R, and ε are public; the objective is hidden. R ≥ 0 and ε > 0.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/SmoothAndConvex.lean: Public; LongTails/Setups/RelativeErrorSmoothConvex.lean: Public, spec.Params, spec.publicInput, spec.Instance, spec.valid.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a single point x with f(x) − f(xstar) ≤ ε for a global minimizer xstar.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: The objective-gap guarantee holds almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, using a fixed oracle-call budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex minimization uses a standard relative gradient-error model, but imposes an unusual accuracy-dependent inverse-logarithmic error threshold, with arbitrary history dependence and an almost-sure guarantee in a general Hilbert space.
